panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Health checks, scrapes and the notification stream excluded.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: From the SLO buckets in application.properties.

panels.title: Unhandled errors
panels.description: Requests that reached the catch-all exception handler.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{stack="$env", uri!~"/health.*|/prometheus|/api/notifications/stream"}[$__range])) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{stack="$env", uri!~"/health.*|/prometheus|/api/notifications/stream"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Problems returned by code
panels.description: RFC 9457 problem codes sent to clients.

panels.title: Calendar days left
panels.description: Days of reference calendar left; negative means already past its end.

panels.title: Audit partitions ahead
panels.description: Monthly audit partitions created ahead; at zero every command fails.

panels.title: DB connection wait (avg)
panels.description: Time a request waits for a pooled connection; rising means the pool is too small.

panels.title: Backend errors
panels.description: ERROR lines from the backend in the selected time range.

panels.title: Backend starts
panels.description: Spring Boot start-ups: a deploy or a crash loop.

panels.title: Top error types
panels.description: Exception class from the ECS error.type field.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (error_type) (count_over_time({service="backend", container=~"$env-.*", level="ERROR"} | json error_type="[\"error.type\"]" | error_type != "" [$__range])))
topk(10, sum by (message) (count_over_time({service="backend", container=~"$env-.*", level="ERROR"} | json message="message" [$__range])))

{service="backend", container=~"$env-.*", level=~"ERROR|WARN"} | json | line_format "{{.container}} · {{.log_logger}} · {{.message}}{{ if .error_type }} · {{.error_type}}: {{.error_message}}{{ end }}"

panels.title: All backend lines for trace id
panels.description: Paste a traceId (from a problem+json error or any backend line) into the Trace id box at the top.

targets.expr: {service="backend", container=~"$env-.*"} | traceId="$trace" | json | line_format "{{.container}} · {{.log_logger}} · {{.message}}{{ if .error_type }} · {{.error_type}}: {{.error_message}}{{ end }}"

panels.title: Log search
panels.description: Case-insensitive regex from the Search box over the selected services.
